description: Source code for the FXOS8700 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing SPI and I2C communication, sensor configuration, data fetching, and initialization.

methods.name: fxos8700_transceive
methods.description: Performs SPI transceive operation with the device.

methods.name: fxos8700_read_spi
methods.description: Reads data from the device over SPI.

methods.name: fxos8700_byte_read_spi
methods.description: Reads a byte from the device over SPI.

methods.name: fxos8700_byte_write_spi
methods.description: Writes a byte to the device over SPI.

methods.name: fxos8700_reg_field_update_spi
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register over SPI.

methods.name: fxos8700_read_i2c
methods.description: Reads data from the device over I2C.

methods.name: fxos8700_byte_read_i2c
methods.description: Reads a byte from the device over I2C.

methods.name: fxos8700_byte_write_i2c
methods.description: Writes a byte to the device over I2C.

methods.name: fxos8700_reg_field_update_i2c
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register over I2C.

methods.name: fxos8700_set_odr
methods.description: Sets the output data rate of the sensor.

methods.name: fxos8700_set_mt_ths
methods.description: Sets the motion threshold.

methods.name: fxos8700_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes like sampling frequency and slope threshold.

methods.name: fxos8700_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor sample data.

methods.name: fxos8700_accel_convert
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor_value.

methods.name: fxos8700_magn_convert
methods.description: Converts raw magnetometer data to sensor_value.

methods.name: fxos8700_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value.

methods.name: fxos8700_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves specific sensor channel data.

methods.name: fxos8700_get_power
methods.description: Gets current power mode of the device.

methods.name: fxos8700_set_power
methods.description: Sets power mode of the device.

methods.name: fxos8700_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, configures registers, and prepares for operation.
